about: Scripts for the punctuation corpus. The same text is spoken by TTS (Tools/make_punctuation_corpus.py) and read aloud by a person (Tools/record_punctuation_corpus.swift), so synthetic and live results compare item by item. References are punctuated the way the dictation should read; a blank line is a paragraph. Russian and Ukrainian yes-no questions carry no question word, so only intonation marks them; German and English ones are marked by word order. Indirect questions contain a question word but are statements.
